svg.title: modeck：从资源分散维护，到工作方式统一组织
svg.desc: 左侧：Claude Code 和 Codex 的全局、项目技能与配置分布在各自入口，跨 agent 复用需自行协调。右侧：个人配置与团队配置各自声明 rules、skills 和 modes，经 modeck 注册和选择启用；agent 适配层集中管理原生路径与 hook，当前仅支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 CodeBuddy。仅绑定时由 Rulesync 36.0.2 在隔离目录转换 SessionStart hook，再由 modeck plan/apply 合并原生 hook 配置；不转换 rules/skills 格式。会话运行时仍通过 .modes 或自动选择脚本动态选择工作模式，SessionStart 加载规则正文与技能索引，技能按需读取。个人和团队是普通配置目录的组织方式。模型与权限由原生 agent 管理，外部资源先安装，会话启动不下载。
svg.metadata: {"reviewDate": "2026-10-17", "modeckEvidence": ["src/cli/manage-config.ts", "src/integration/registry.ts", "src/integration/prepare.ts", "src/core/resolve.ts", "src/core/compile.ts", "src/integration/hooks.ts", "src/integration/native-skills.ts", "src/resources/repository.ts", "src/contracts/agents.ts", "src/integration/formats.ts", "src/integration/install.ts", "package.json"], "nativeSources": ["https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills", "https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings", "https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory", "https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/build-skills", "https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/config-file/config-basic", "https://developers.openai.com/codex/guides/agents-md"], "notes": ["Native cards show common local entry points, not an exhaustive list.", "Personal/team are user-organized config directories, not permission roles.", "base, prog, tbase and tdoc are illustrative user-defined mode names.", "Resource index is additional context, not native slash command registration.", "A shared enabled configuration set is used by bound agents.", "Supported agents remain Claude Code, Codex and CodeBuddy only.", "The adapter centralizes native paths and hooks.", "Rulesync 36.0.2 converts only SessionStart hooks at bind time in an isolated directory; modeck plan/apply merges the generated hook group.", "Rulesync does not convert rule or skill formats; mode selection and context compilation remain dynamic at runtime."]}
